summary: Regression testing passed for backend dashboard/CRUD and mobile navigation, modal title, overflow, and sales/staff form submission. One desktop staff table layout defect remains.

ui_bugs.issue: Staff rows render four fields but .table-head/.table-row always use three grid columns; Durum wraps into a second line under Personel instead of aligning as a fourth column.

action_items: Use a four-column grid for the staff table (or derive columns from the fields) so Durum aligns with its header.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend demo values and API-unavailable fallback are intentionally MOCKED; keep them clearly distinguished from persisted data.
seed_data_creation: Created two temporary TEST_UI records through the UI and deleted both by exact IDs after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile navigation now exposes all seven management links, has no horizontal overflow, and cash modal title is non-empty. Recheck staff table after grid fix.
rca of the issue: ListView always applies a three-column CSS grid, while staff passes name, shift, task, and status; the fourth item wraps into the first grid track's next row.
